product_summary: SNF India Pvt. Ltd. is a group company of the French SNF (Floerger) group, listed on the group's own locations page (snf.com, 'SNF India Pvt. Ltd.' and sister entity 'SNF Flopam India Pvt. Ltd.'). The group's product lines are water-soluble synthetic polymers: polyacrylamide flocculants/coagulants for municipal and industrial water treatment, enhanced-oil-recovery (EOR) polymers, mining and pulp&paper process chemicals, textile sizing polymers (FLOSIZE), agriculture and personal-care specialties. The India entity's own activity is documented on snf.com/en/india/ (news item, published 31.03.2026): SNF Flopam India was awarded an INR 547 crore ONGC Mehsana contract for 'Hiring of Polymer Injection Facilities – Phase 2' at Bechraji field, scope = design, supply, installation, commissioning and O&M of polymer injection skids, hydration units, pumping systems, utilities and pipeline networks, plus supply of polymer and other chemicals. So the real product mix is (a) acrylamide-based polymers/polyacrylamides in solid and emulsion form, (b) chemical EOR formulations, (c) polymer injection/hydration/pumping skids and surface facilities as an engineered package.
comment: HS 730900 ('reservoirs, tanks, vats and similar containers of iron or steel, capacity >300 l') is WRONG for this company: it is a specialty-polymer/chemical producer, not a fabricator of steel tanks. The declared code looks like a mis-mapping of the 'polymer injection skids / surface facilities' wording in the ONGC project scope, or a generic 'oil & gas equipment' default. Correct HS-6 for the actual goods: 390690 (acrylic polymers, incl. polyacrylamide, in primary forms) — main line; 382440 (prepared additives for cements/mortars/concretes) only if construction-chemistry grades are sold; 390610/390690 for other polymer specialties; the engineered skids/pipeline networks would fall under 8479.89 / 8421.21 / 7309/7304 depending on the item, but these are project-scope items, not the company's core catalogue. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is only half right: the primary industry is specialty chemicals / water treatment polymers; oil & gas is one end-market (EOR). Trader signs: the group operates a dedicated trading arm (SNF Trading ME FZE) and the India entity both manufactures locally and imports group-produced polymers, so manufacturer_trader is the honest role. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground — company is kept and the code is corrected to 390690 as the primary line. IMPORTANT: no customs/B-L line was available to me in this task (product/HS scope only), so the actual export/import HS lines are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — the mapping above is derived from the company's own published product and project descriptions, not from a customs record. Revenue, shipment volumes and registry data were out of scope and are null.
